chapter_title_en: The Wind Rises Overseas, Meeting Zi Ling Again
chapter_seo_title: Void Heaven Palace Opens | Han Li Reunites with Zi Ling & Faces Extreme Yin’s Schemes
chapter_meta_description: The Star Palace seals the hall and reveals a hidden teleportation to the Void Heaven Palace. Han Li is teleported with a desperate Fairy Zi Ling, who seeks his protection in exchange for an old debt.
og_title: Chapter 443 – Wind Rises Overseas, Reunited with Zi Ling
og_description: The Void Heaven Palace trial begins! Star Palace’s secret teleportation scatters cultivators, and Han Li must choose whether to shield a fragile old acquaintance.
twitter_title: Void Heaven Palace Awakens: Han Li Meets Zi Ling
twitter_description: An old debt forces Han Li to offer protection as the ancient ruin opens. But Extreme Yin’s shadow looms large.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary floating jade palace in the Chaotic Star Sea, sealed by ancient restrictions and opened periodically for a deadly trial to claim its treasures.
A transitional cultivation stage at the peak of Foundation Establishment where the core is not yet fully solid; cultivators at this stage are desperately seeking breakthrough aids.
A thousand-year-old ghost cultivator who sacrificed his reincarnation to become a Profound Soul Body; he claims to be the former master of Extreme Yin’s founder.
The dominant power in the Chaotic Star Sea, known for its iron control and hidden schemes; sends white-robed elders to supervise the Void Heaven Palace trial.
A rare spiritual wood Han Li obtained from the Sublime Sound Sect, used for making lightning-type magical tools.
